name: dsh-context-reclaim
description: DSH plugin: context reclaim at tool-result creation time, and at every later seam where context grows. Lossless noise purification, per-content-type bounding with retrieval pointers, tool-definition folding, system-prompt section-order stabilisation, and prompt-line trimming. Five Cordis seams, zero runtime dependencies. Also takes over the host's writable-request path, so the official `dsh-llm` file patch is no longer needed, and reports — without ever applying — which other official file patches are present. Never rewrites committed history, so the provider prefix cache is never invalidated.
